cohort: 736,435 California infants born between 2005 and 2011 were included in the analysis.
finding: SES and SGA exhibited independent effects on a majority of newborn metabolites and joint effects on select metabolites, including alanine, glycine, free carnitine, C-3DC, C-5DC, C-16:1, C-18:1, and C-18:2.
birth_weight: N/A (SGA was defined by birthweight <10th percentile for gestational age by sex)
gest_age: N/A (gestational age was used in the definition of SGA)
